mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME, pi.IMAGE_URL as IMAGE_URL FROM sales s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.SELLER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON s.SALE_ITEM_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'sale' AND pi.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' WHERE s.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} ORDER BY s.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME as SELLER_NAME, pi.IMAGE_URL as IMAGE_URL FROM sales s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.SELLER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON s.SALE_ITEM_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'sale' AND pi.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' WHERE s.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert:

INSERT INTO product_images ( IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, IMAGE_URL, IS_THUMBNAIL, ORDER_INDEX, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_IMAGE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, 'sale', #{imageUrl},
'y' 'n' , #{orderIndex}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales SET QTY = #{qty}, SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}, JUDGE_KIND_NAME = #{judgeKindName}, CUT_NAME = #{cutName}, TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, DETAIL_DESCRIPTION = #{detailDescription}, WEIGHT = #{weight}, PRICE = #{price}, GRADE = #{grade}, TRACEABILITY_NUM = #{traceabilityNum} WHERE SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_images WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND PRODUCT_TYPE = 'sale'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_images ( IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, IMAGE_URL, IS_THUMBNAIL, ORDER_INDEX, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( image_seq.NEXTVAL, #{reviewId}, 'REVIEW', #{imageUrl}, #{isThumbnail}, #{orderIndex}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
